observations.name: Room baseline
observations.observation: BOOHTACORD is foreground in SHARE_TEST; the room shows one participant, microphone disabled, and an 8 ms RTT indicator.

observations.name: Full-display local preview
observations.observation: The Android system picker was set to show the whole display. After consent, the local stream preview showed live recursive screen pixels rather than a black frame; the participant card also showed its thumbnail.

observations.name: Background projection/service continuity (mic muted)
observations.observation: After BOOHTACORD was sent to Home for about one minute, dumpsys still showed TYPE_SCREEN_CAPTURE and the IsolateHolderService foreground with mediaProjection type. The app process remained alive.

observations.name: Resume and cleanup
observations.observation: The existing MainActivity returned with LaunchState HOT, the voice screen still showed Connected, one room participant and RTT 8 ms, and the screen preview was visible. Stopping from the dock cleared MediaProjection and left no active app service; the voice room remained connected.

limitations: The Pixel microphone stayed muted throughout; background microphone capture remains untested under FE-68.
Only full-display capture was tested. App-only capture and its privacy blanking behavior were not re-tested.
The room showed one participant, so no paired remote observer was confirmed; receiver decoded frames and remote crop/playback remain unverified.
remaining: Repeat with a paired browser/Mac receiver and collect bounded sender encoded-frame and receiver decoded-frame counters; separately test app-only capture and (if required) background voice with microphone enabled.
